summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Committed Equity Forward Purchase Agreement with LucentHash / Data Part Capital for up to $50M of common stock. The company may, at its sole discretion, sell shares at 95% of VWAP over five-day pricing periods, subject to a $5.00 floor price ($3.00 minimum on reset). Draws are $50k-$5M each, with 14-day gaps, and shares are restricted for nine months with short-sale prohibition. The company controls timing and amount; no obligation to draw. The facility provides equity-linked capital without immediate dilution, akin to an at-the-market offering with a forward component. Watch draw frequency and floor-price resets; no board advisor named.
